verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a real-time webhook system covering delivery, bounce, open-tracking, and inbound-message events, with dedicated docs for setup, payload validation, and security (HMAC/IP allowlisting), plus TypeScript examples for parsing and idempotency — directly enabling event-driven/agentic subscription to email events. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of webhook reliability/latency and no evidence of a generic event-subscription API beyond the documented webhook types.
